blocks.text: The Miss Universe pageant will celebrate its 75th edition this year with a new crown for the next winner, the 14th design in the international competition’s history. Miss Universe Organization (MUO) CEO Ronald Day unveiled the new piece, dubbed “The Radiance of an Eternal Legacy,” at “The Miss Universe Experience” event held at Plaza Las Americas in San Juan, Puerto Rico, on Nov. 12 (13 in Manila).
